text: Sat tea tasting who can make it?
Sat afternoon? I can do after 2
Sat afternoon ok. I open at 10 anyway. Come whenever after 2, I'll have the 2019 sheng out
2019 is good
Sorry was at a client thing. Sat I can do but not before 4
4 works? Wei you ok with 4
Yeah 4 is fine
4 ok. Hotpot after?
Yes hotpot. Where? Last time was the place by the bridge, too greasy lol
[link: hotpot place on Dianping]
One that's not the bridge place. This one has proper beef tallow, not too much chili
That looks ok. Booking for 6?
Do 5:30 so we don't eat too late
Need to check the pu'er stock first, supplier might not have delivered. Will confirm tonight
Ok
Anyone know if the roads by the river are closed sat? Saw something about repairs
No idea. Checked, it's only one lane closed till the 20th, shouldn't matter
Great
Supplier came. Pu'er confirmed. 2019 sheng plus a white tea from fujian, 4pm still good
Perfect
Morning. Pu'er is in the back, I'll bring the cake for after
Ooh yes the cake from the place near the temple?
That one. Ordered yesterday
Sat 4pm at the shop, hotpot 5:30 then. I'll message the group the booking code when I have it
Wait is the hotpot place near the shop or do we walk
Taxi, 10 min. It's on the south road
Ok good, my knee's been dodgy since the wall on Thursday so I'd rather not walk in the cold
Ugh sorry, hope it's ok. Did you ice it
Yeah it's mostly fine, just stiff going down stairs
Booking code: HP4471. Name is Wei
Thanks. I'll pay the deposit tonight
Did the 2019 sheng age well? Sounds like you've had it a while
Been in the cupboard since spring. Stored right, it's fine. Tastes softer now
Can't wait. I'll bring the good cups
Morning. Shop's open. Cake box came early, sitting on the counter
[screenshot: deposit receipt]
Deposit done
👍 thanks
Release day and the checkout bug is back. Third time this month
Which one
The one where the discount doesn't apply if you go back a page
Ouch. Did they blame you
Not yet
Knee's ok on the stairs today. Still don't want to climb Thursday though
Rest it. Thursday's not going anywhere
Quiet afternoon. Someone left a thermos on the bench, I've put it by the till
If it's yours come get it
[link: Chengdu Traffic Bureau notice, river road repair]
They've reopened both lanes from tomorrow. Not one lane
Yue you said it was only one till the 20th
Ah. Sorry, that was from a Sunday post, I didn't look at the date
Anyway both lanes is better for the taxi
Yeah. Fine
Can't sleep. Going through test cases in my head
Sat, the good cups. I'm checking they're not chipped
Late. Still thinking about the pu'er. Supplier says the batch is slightly different from the last one
Will tell you Sat
